headline: Athens Airport Becomes Europe's Largest Urban Green Space
meta_description: A former Athens airport is being transformed into a massive urban park with 30,000 trees and 3 million shrubs across 70% green coverage.
summary_short: The Ellinikon Park in Athens will transform a defunct airport into one of Europe's largest urban green spaces, featuring over 30,000 trees.
body:
A former airport in Elliniko, Greece is undergoing a remarkable transformation into one of Europe's largest urban green spaces. The Ellinikon Park will cover 70 per cent of its area with greenery, including more than 30,000 trees and around three million shrubs.

The project represents a bold reimagining of urban land use—converting abandoned airport infrastructure into a thriving natural oasis at the heart of the metropolitan area. This shift reflects a growing recognition that cities can reclaim industrial spaces for public benefit and environmental gain.

When complete, the park will serve as a verdant refuge for residents and a habitat for urban wildlife, breathing new ecological life into what was once a hub of aviation activity.
quick_facts: Former airport in Elliniko, Greece being converted to urban park
30,000 trees and 3 million shrubs planted across the site
70 per cent of the area covered in greenery
One of Europe's largest urban green spaces when complete
